use default

proper_divisors(n: int) -> LIST[int] is
    let divisors = LIST([1])
    let candidate mut = 2

    while candidate * candidate <= n do
        if n % candidate == 0 then
            divisors.add(candidate)

            if candidate != n / candidate then
                divisors.add(n / candidate)
            fi
        fi

        candidate = candidate + 1
    od

    divisors
si

sums_to(divisors: List[int], from: int, target: int) -> bool =>
    if target == 0 then
        true
    elif from >= divisors.count then
        false
    elif divisors[from] > target then
        sums_to(divisors, from + 1, target)
    else
        sums_to(divisors, from + 1, target - divisors[from]) \/
            sums_to(divisors, from + 1, target)
    fi

weird(n: int) -> bool =>
    (let divisors = proper_divisors(n) |> sort_descending() |> collect()

     divisors |> reduce(0, (total: int, d: int) => total + d) > n /\
         !sums_to(divisors, 0, n))

stream(2, n => n || n + 1)
    |> filter(weird)
    |> take(25)
    |> chunk(5)
    |> each(row =>
        write_line(row |> map((n: int) => "{n,7}") |> join("")))
